ideas.pitch: A real-time browser extension and verification pipeline that detects audio and video deepfakes in local political discourse and issues cryptographically verifiable authenticity badges.
ideas.title: AuraTrust: Deepfake Misinformation Shield for Local Governance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Cybersecurity & Digital Trust theme with an actionable browser-based tool allows judges to immediately test the product live during the tight 8-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered voice-to-text governance portal that translates regional dialects into structured grievance tickets for local municipal authorities.
ideas.title: GramVani: Multilingual Accessibility Engine for Public Scheme Grievances
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the AI for Real-World Impact theme by directly solving administrative friction in Indian governance, appealing strongly to IEEE judges focused on societal utility.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight forecasting dashboard that predicts solar energy generation for institutional rooftops using weather covariates and suggests optimal load shifting.
ideas.title: EcoGrid: Micro-Campus Solar Output Forecaster and Load Shifter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with ClimateTech & Sustainable Innovation while utilizing a regression-based forecasting model similar to proven hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A quantized LLM-backed web application that runs localized quizzes and generates personalized study remediation for students in rural classrooms without stable internet.
ideas.title: EduAccess: Offline-First AI Adaptive Tutor for Low-Bandwidth Classrooms
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses educational accessibility in the AI for Real-World Impact theme with a heavy emphasis on practical deployment constraints in developing regions.

ideas.pitch: A simulation dashboard that ingests synthetic IoT sensor streams from urban water networks to detect anomalous pressure drops and potential contamination in real-time.
ideas.title: AquaSense: IoT Water Quality and Leakage Detection Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the water sub-theme within ClimateTech & Sustainable Innovation with an interactive visualization that is easy for judges to evaluate within the 8-hour timeframe.
